#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Detect palindromes in a given text file."""

import argparse
import re
import sys


def normalize(text):
    """Lowercase text and keep only alphanumeric characters."""
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", text.lower())


def is_palindrome(text):
    """Return True if normalized text reads the same forwards and backwards."""
    cleaned = normalize(text)
    return len(cleaned) > 0 and cleaned == cleaned[::-1]


def find_palindromic_words(text):
    """Return unique palindromic words found in text, in order of appearance."""
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for word in re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9']+", text):
        if is_palindrome(word) and word.lower() not in seen:
            seen.add(word.lower())
            result.append(word)
    return result


def find_palindromic_lines(lines):
    """Return (line_number, line) pairs whose full content is a palindrome."""
    return [(i, line) for i, line in enumerate(lines, start=1) if is_palindrome(line)]


def detect_palindromes(path):
    """Read the file and return a report string describing palindromes found."""
    try:
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            lines = handle.read().splitlines()
    except OSError as exc:
        raise SystemExit(f"Error: cannot read '{path}': {exc}")

    report = []
    pal_lines = find_palindromic_lines(lines)
    report.append(f"Palindromic lines: {len(pal_lines)}")
    for number, line in pal_lines:
        report.append(f"  Line {number}: {line.strip()}")

    words = find_palindromic_words("\n".join(lines))
    report.append(f"Palindromic words: {len(words)}")
    for word in words:
        report.append(f"  {word}")
    return "\n".join(report)

    parser.add_argument("file", help="Path to the text file to analyze.")
    parser.add_argument("--words-only", action="store_true", help="Report only palindromic words.")

    if not args.words_only:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Detect palindromes in a given text file.

Usage:
    python main.py <file> [--words-only] [--lines-only]

Reports palindromic lines (whole line reads the same backwards, ignoring
case, spaces and punctuation) and palindromic words found in the file.
"""

import argparse
import re
import sys


def normalize(text):
    """Lowercase text and keep only alphanumeric characters (Unicode-aware)."""
    return "".join(ch.lower() for ch in text if ch.isalnum())


def is_palindrome(text):
    """Return True if normalized text is non-empty and reads the same both ways."""
    cleaned = normalize(text)
    return bool(cleaned) and cleaned == cleaned[::-1]


def palindromic_lines(lines):
    """Return (line_number, line) pairs whose whole content is a palindrome."""
    return [(n, line) for n, line in enumerate(lines, start=1) if is_palindrome(line)]


def palindromic_words(lines):
    """Return unique palindromic words in order of first appearance."""
    seen, found = set(), []
    for word in re.findall(r"[^\W_]+", "\n".join(lines), flags=re.UNICODE):
        if is_palindrome(word) and word.lower() not in seen:
            seen.add(word.lower())
            found.append(word)
    return found


def analyze(path, words_only=False, lines_only=False):
    """Read the text file and print a palindrome report."""
    try:
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            lines = handle.read().splitlines()
    except OSError as exc:
        sys.exit(f"Error: cannot read '{path}': {exc}")

    if not words_only:
        hits = palindromic_lines(lines)
        print(f"Palindromic lines: {len(hits)}")
        for number, line in hits:
            print(f"  Line {number}: {line.strip()}")

    if not lines_only:
        words = palindromic_words(lines)
        print(f"Palindromic words: {len(words)}")
        for word in words:
            print(f"  {word}")


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Detect palindromes in a text file.")
    parser.add_argument("file", help="Path to the text file to analyze.")
    parser.add_argument("--words-only", action="store_true",
                        help="Report only palindromic words.")
    parser.add_argument("--lines-only", action="store_true",
                        help="Report only palindromic lines.")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    analyze(args.file, args.words_only, args.lines_only)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
